node.KiLoRALoadMod.name: KiLoRA Load Mod
node.KiLoRALoadMod.desc: Loads one KiLoRA mod into a copy of the model. Use it like a LoRA loader.
node.KiLoRAModInfo.name: KiLoRA Mod Info
node.KiLoRAModInfo.desc: Shows the creator's hints for a mod: strength, trigger words, example prompt and depth.
node.KiLoRAClear.name: KiLoRA Remove Mods
node.KiLoRAClear.desc: Removes all KiLoRA mods from a model.
node.KiLoRASelect.name: KiLoRA Mod List: Add Mod
node.KiLoRASelect.desc: Adds one mod to a mod list. Chain several, then connect the list to KiLoRA Apply Mod List.
node.KiLoRAImportLoRA.name: KiLoRA Mod List: Add LoRA
node.KiLoRAImportLoRA.desc: Adds a plain LoRA file to a mod list.
node.KiLoRALoadOrder.name: KiLoRA Mod List: Check
node.KiLoRALoadOrder.desc: Shows the load order and any problems. The model is not changed.
node.KiLoRAApply.name: KiLoRA Apply Mod List
node.KiLoRAApply.desc: Loads all mods of a mod list into a copy of the model.
node.KiLoRALiveRecord.name: KiLoRA Live: 1. Record (before sampler)
node.KiLoRALiveRecord.desc: Put before the sampler to record a live mod or imported LoRAs, even without a live mod.
node.KiLoRALiveWrite.name: KiLoRA Live: 2. Write (after sampler)
node.KiLoRALiveWrite.desc: Live mode, step 2. Put it after the sampler. The editor updates the live mod. You can undo it. A guard refuses a write that lowers prompt following or collapses the image. Without the CLIP on Record, the guard is off.
node.KiLoRALiveOptions.name: KiLoRA Live: Settings
node.KiLoRALiveOptions.desc: Turns learning on or off, and sets the learning speed.
node.KiLoRALiveSave.name: KiLoRA Live: Undo, Reset, Save
node.KiLoRALiveSave.desc: Undo, reset, save points and loading for a live mod.
node.KiLoRAFreeze.name: KiLoRA Live: Freeze as Static Mod
node.KiLoRAFreeze.desc: Saves the live mod's current state as a new static mod.
node.KiLoRALiveExport.name: KiLoRA Live: Export for Sharing
node.KiLoRALiveExport.desc: Saves a live mod for sharing. By default without what it learned from you.
tip.candidate_summary: Choose content keys or leading read-map directions to select candidates.
tip.candidates: Choose this many experts before routing. 0 or at least the expert count uses every expert.
in.name: name
tip.model: The model to load into. The original model is not changed.
tip.mod_file: A KiLoRA mod file from models/kilora.
tip.strength: 1 is the trained strength. 0 turns the mod off. Negative values push away from the mod.
tip.depth: Number of passes. -1 uses the depth the mod recommends (imported LoRAs: 4).
tip.iteration: How depth passes work. mod: the mode the mod chose. accumulate: each pass adds its change. path: each pass picks the next expert, and the result is that expert's change.
tip.routing_scope: Which logits choose the experts. mod: the scope stored in each mod. token: each token on its own. tensor: the mean over all tokens, one choice for the whole tensor.
tip.routing_select: How the logits become expert weights. mod: the selection stored in each mod. sparsemax: weights that sum to 1, weak experts at 0. top1: only the best expert.
tip.prior: How much the router prefers this mod when mods share a layer. 1 is neutral.
tip.sets: A mod list from another mod list node. Leave empty to start a new list.
tip.enabled: Off keeps it in the list, but does not load it.
tip.lora_strength: The LoRA weight, as in a LoRA loader. 0.7 is the recommended strength in a KiLoRA mix.
tip.check_model: The model the list would load into. It is not changed.
tip.apply_sets: The mod list from the last mod list node.
tip.clear_model: The model to remove KiLoRA mods from.
tip.applied: The model from KiLoRA Load Mod or KiLoRA Apply Mod List, with a live mod.
tip.editor: A live-mode editor file (.kedit) from models/kilora, made for this base model.
tip.empty_clip: The text encoder. The live measurement averages the loss under the prompt and under an empty caption; it encodes the empty caption with this. Without it, the negative prompt of a guided sampler stands in.
tip.path: The record output of KiLoRA Live: 1. Record.
tip.samples: The latent from the sampler. It passes through unchanged.
tip.live_mod: The ID of the live mod. Leave empty if only one is loaded.
tip.learning: On: the mod learns from your images. Off: it keeps its state.
tip.speed: Learning speed. -1 uses the mod's default. Higher values change the mod faster.
tip.action: undo: one step back. reset: back to the start (undo restores it). save point, load: named saves.
tip.save_name: The name of the save point.
tip.mod_all: The ID of the live mod, or all.
tip.new_id: The ID of the new mod. Use lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore or dash.
tip.include_state: Off: share the mod without what it learned from you.
tip.export_id: The ID of the shared mod. Leave empty to keep the ID.
otip.sets: Connect it to the next mod list node or to KiLoRA Apply Mod List.
otip.record_model: Connect this model to the sampler.
otip.record_path: Connect it to KiLoRA Live: 2. Write.
otip.samples: The latent from the sampler, unchanged.
err.no_file: No {kind} selected. Put a file into {where}, refresh ComfyUI and pick it.
err.not_found: The {kind} {name} was not found in {where}. Refresh ComfyUI and pick it again.
err.strength: Strength must be a number from {low} to {high}.
err.no_editor: No live-mode editor found. Put the editor file (.kedit.safetensors) into ComfyUI/models/kilora, then refresh ComfyUI.
err.not_editor: {name} is not a live-mode editor. Pick a live-mode editor made for this mod.
err.wrong_base: Wrong base model: this editor is made for {families}, but the mod is for {family}. Pick an editor made for {family}.
err.hook_mismatch: This editor does not fit this mod: they differ at the layer {layer}. Use the editor made for this mod.
err.size_mismatch: This editor does not fit this mod: the sizes differ at the layer {layer}. Use the editor made for this mod.
err.no_live_mod: No live mod is loaded. Connect the model from KiLoRA Load Mod or KiLoRA Apply Mod List, with a live mod in it.
err.gate_history_width: gate_history head:k works with path width 1 only. Set path_width to 1, or gate_history to full.
err.mod_not_fit: This mod does not fit the loaded model. It needs the layer {layer}, which the {family} model does not have. Check that the mod is made for {family}.
msg.oom: Not enough GPU memory: sampling stopped, so live mode learned nothing. Free memory or use a smaller image, then try again.
msg.not_finished: Sampling did not finish, so live mode learned nothing this time.
msg.nothing_recorded: Nothing was recorded. Connect the model from KiLoRA Live: 1. Record to the sampler.
msg.learning_off: Learning is off for this mod, so nothing was learned. Turn it on in KiLoRA Live: Settings.
msg.cross_layer_jvp_unavailable: Cross-layer jvp is not available for these layers. RLS links are used.
msg.no_write: The editor made no write this time. The mod is unchanged.
msg.invalid_write: Discarded: the write had invalid values. Nothing changed.
msg.guard_refused: Refused by the guard: {why} Nothing changed.
msg.guard_follow: the write lowered prompt following from {before} to {after}.
msg.guard_spread: the write changed the image spread {ratio} times (collapse or saturation).
msg.guard_off_measure: Guard off: this write has no image measurement. Connect the CLIP to Live Record, or sample with guidance.
msg.guard_off_editor: Guard off: this editor gives the guard no trial.
otip.strength: The recommended strength. Connect it to a strength input.
otip.trigger: The trigger words. Add them to your prompt.
otip.example: An example prompt from the creator.
tip.keep_previous: on: the live state also keeps the last image and its prompt, for editors that compare two images. unchanged: keep the current choice.
msg.queued: Learning from this image runs in the background (write {number}). The next image uses what is learned when it starts.
tip.measure_size: Expert. The longer side, in pixels, of the copy that learning measures: 256 to 4096, rounded to 16. Type the image size to measure at full size (slower). 0: unchanged. The default is 512.
tip.controller: Choose the imported edit controller. R1 keeps the existing rule; Rprop adapts each move separately.
tip.measure: How the imported editor measures its moves. compressed: a fixed number of random combinations of all moves per write, two passes each, then an estimate of every slope. full: two passes per move, slower. unchanged: keep the current choice. The default is compressed.
tip.measure_combos: The number of random combinations that the compressed measurement uses per write. A write costs two passes per combination. 0: unchanged. The default is 8.
tip.live_expert_mass: A live write edits an expert only if its route mass on the recorded paths is above this fraction of its layer's mass. -1: unchanged. The default is 0.05.
tip.live_expert_top: The most experts per layer that one live write edits, by route mass. 0: unchanged. The default is 4.
tip.live_expert_history: The number of recorded prompts whose route mass the session keeps to find shared experts. 0: unchanged. The default is 16.
tip.live_expert_copies: The most copies of one shared expert that live writes add. -1: unchanged. The default is 2.
tip.write_measure: How a live write finds its direction. forward: one clean forward and a set of forwards with small noise on the outputs of the target experts (the default). candidates: measure each candidate move with paired forwards. unchanged keeps the current choice.
tip.forward_draws: The number of noise draws of the forward estimate. More draws give a steadier direction and cost more time. 0: unchanged. The default is 4.
tip.forward_sigma: The size of the forward estimate's noise, as a fraction of the output RMS of each expert. -1: unchanged. The default is 0.05.
tip.forward_chunk: The number of sample rows in one model call of a write. A row is one noise sample or one noise draw. A lower number uses less GPU memory. 0: unchanged. The default is 8.
tip.write_resolution: The long side, in pixels, of the samples of a write. A write learns from a smaller copy of the image: 256 to 4096, rounded to 16. A lower number makes a write faster. 0: the render resolution. -1: unchanged. The default is 512. Writes already ran at 512 px before this setting: they used the measurement size (measure_size). This setting names that control.
tip.measure_samples: The noise samples of one write. The write draws each sample for itself: a noise level from the model's training schedule and a noise image. Every trial of the write uses the same samples. The accept check uses the same number of other samples. More samples measure more steadily and cost more time.
tip.pin: Keep rendering the current state while learning continues. Off follows the latest write; unchanged keeps the current setting.
tip.reduce_with: How the smaller copy is made. latent: fast, no VAE needed. decode-resize-encode: needs the VAE input of KiLoRA Live: 2. Write. unchanged: keep the current choice.
tip.vae: Optional. The VAE, for the reduction decode-resize-encode.
tip.measurement: How the editor measures each direction. central: two passes, more exact. one-sided: one pass plus a shared base pass, faster. unchanged: keep the current choice.
tip.editor_keep_merge_pairs: Keep before and after coefficients for up to 32 merges per branch. Off by default.
tip.editor_path_merge: Merge observed expert paths into the editor state. On by default. unchanged keeps the current choice.
tip.time_bins: The number of noise levels at which the editor measures: 1 or 2. unchanged: keep the current choice.
tip.families: Optional. Family packs to use next to the common pack, as a comma list of family names (for example ink_line). Empty: auto takes the mod's family pack, or all installed family packs.
node.KiLoRALivePacks.name: KiLoRA Live: Editor Packs
node.KiLoRALivePacks.desc: Lists the installed editor packs, turns packs on or off, and shows the packs of the loaded save.
tip.packs: auto: the common pack and the pack for the mod's family. common only: only the common pack. pinned: the pack versions of the loaded save.
tip.turned_off: Pack IDs to turn off, separated by commas.
tip.editor_kind: The editor of the packs. Leave empty if packs of only one editor are installed.
node.KiLoRARegion.name: KiLoRA Mod List: Region
node.KiLoRARegion.desc: Limits the mods of a mod list to the masked area of the image. Each mod chooses its experts from that area. Chain lists with different masks to place mods in different areas.
tip.region_mask: White areas get the change; black areas stay as they are. Soft edges blend.
tip.apply_to: whole list: every mod in the incoming list. last mod: only the mod added last.
err.region_empty: The mod list is empty. Add a mod before KiLoRA Region.
tip.region_caption: Optional. A caption for the marked region. It names the concept, so later generations can find it. It needs the CLIP on Record.
msg.region_caption_needs_clip: The region caption needs the CLIP on KiLoRA Live: 1. Record. The prompt was used instead.
node.KiLoRADepthSchedule.name: KiLoRA Depth Schedule
node.KiLoRADepthSchedule.desc: Sets the depth of each block, also by sampling progress, from a list, a preset or an expression. Connect it to KiLoRA Apply Mod List.
tip.schedule: A list (one depth per block, the last value repeats), a preset name or an expression with i, n, t, self, cross and mlp. If it is empty, the preset applies.
tip.schedule_preset: Applies when the schedule text is empty. none: no schedule, the depth input applies.
tip.schedule_blocks: The number of blocks in the preview.
tip.preview_kind: The layer kind that the preview shows.
tip.depth_schedule: Optional. A KiLoRA Depth Schedule. It replaces the depth input and the default schedule of the mods.
otip.depth_schedule: The schedule. Connect it to KiLoRA Apply Mod List.
otip.schedule_preview: Heatmap: blocks across, sampling progress down. Black is depth 0, yellow is the deepest value.
node.KiLoRARegionAttention.name: KiLoRA Mod List: Region Attention
node.KiLoRARegionAttention.desc: Experimental. Keeps the change of each KiLoRA region inside its region. In a window of sampling after the layout forms, the tokens of a region attend less (soft) or not at all (hard) to tokens outside it. Connect it after KiLoRA Apply.
tip.attention_mode: off: no change. soft: a region looks less at the rest of the image. hard: a region does not look at the rest of the image.
tip.attention_strength: How much less a region looks outside itself in soft mode. Start low: high values change the image.
tip.attention_until: Where the window ends, as a part of the sampler steps. 0.6: the limit stops after 60% of the steps.
tip.outside_region: On: the area outside every region counts as one more region, so it does not look into the regions. Use it for a single region.
msg.region_attention_none: Region attention found no KiLoRA region. Add KiLoRA Region before KiLoRA Apply.
msg.region_attention_on: Region attention: {mode} for {regions} regions, from {start} to {until} of the sampler steps.
tip.output_gate: How each mod's change is limited. mod: the mode the mod chose. auto: adaptive, or both if the mod has a trained gate. adaptive: each output channel and token keeps less of a change that is large against its own base scale or that flips direction. learned: the mod's trained gate only. both: the product. none: no gate.
tip.gate_history: full updates the adaptive gate at every depth step. head:k fixes its keep rates after the first k steps (k must be at least 1).
tip.gate_kappa: The scale of the adaptive gate. A change of kappa times the base scale is kept with probability 0.5. Smaller values limit more. 0 uses the mod's value.
tip.attention_start: Where the window starts, as a part of the sampler steps. Steps before it never change, so the layout forms freely. 0.3: after the first 30% of the steps.
tip.region_text: Optional. A text encoding for this region (from CLIP Text Encode). With region captions on in KiLoRA Region Attention, the region follows this caption instead of the prompt.
tip.region_captions: On: regions with a caption follow their own caption in the same window of steps (regional prompting). The rest of the image follows the prompt.
msg.region_attention_captions: Region captions: {captions} regions follow their own caption.
tip.path_width: Path iteration only. The number of walks: they start from the best experts of the first step, and each walk goes on from its own query. A larger width finds the right expert after a wrong first step. 0 uses the mod's value (imported LoRAs: 3 walks; other mods: 1).
tip.path_select: Path iteration only. How each token picks the result of one walk. mod: the mod's choice. converged: a walk that reached a fixed point wins, then the higher path score. score: the path score only. mix: a mix of the walks, weighted by their path scores.
node.KiLoRASimple.name: KiLoRA Settings (Simple)
node.KiLoRASimple.desc: KiLoRA settings with one choice: how the LoRAs mix. Connect it to the settings input of KiLoRA Apply or a KiLoRA LoRA node. The mix values: balanced: the defaults of KiLoRA Apply, with depth and routing from each mod. keep_each_strong: each token takes only its best LoRA, at full strength (routing scope token, routing select top1). subtle: one pass and one smooth blend per layer (depth 1, routing scope tensor, routing select sparsemax). stack: KiLoRA LoRA Loader does not route and gives the same output as Load LoRA. The other nodes use the balanced values for stack.
node.KiLoRASettings.name: KiLoRA Settings
node.KiLoRASettings.desc: KiLoRA settings: a mix, and single values that replace the values of the mix. Connect it to the settings input of KiLoRA Apply or a KiLoRA LoRA node. Content keys default to per_expert; mix is the compatibility choice. Fused gate statistics are faster; torch reproduces images made before this release.
tip.mix: How the LoRAs mix. balanced: the defaults of KiLoRA Apply, with depth and routing from each mod. keep_each_strong: each token takes only its best LoRA, at full strength (routing scope token, routing select top1). subtle: one pass and one smooth blend per layer (depth 1, routing scope tensor, routing select sparsemax). stack: KiLoRA LoRA Loader does not route and gives the same output as Load LoRA. The other nodes use the balanced values for stack. With balanced, LoRA files route at depth 3 and freeze their routing at 0.4 of the steps; stack is one pass.
tip.apply_settings: Optional. KiLoRA settings. An input of this node that is not at its default replaces the value of the settings.
tip.settings_depth: Number of passes. -2 takes the depth of the mix. -1 uses the depth that the mods recommend.
tip.settings_iteration: How depth passes work. from mix: the value of the mix. mod: the mode the mod chose. accumulate: each pass adds its change. path: each pass picks the next expert, and the result is that expert's change.
tip.settings_routing_scope: Which logits choose the experts. from mix: the value of the mix. mod: the scope stored in each mod. token: each token on its own. tensor: the mean over all tokens, one choice for the whole tensor.
tip.settings_routing_select: How the logits become expert weights. from mix: the value of the mix. mod: the selection stored in each mod. sparsemax: weights that sum to 1, weak experts at 0. top1: only the best expert.
otip.settings: The settings. Connect them to KiLoRA Apply or a KiLoRA LoRA node.
node.KiLoRALoRALoader.name: KiLoRA LoRA Loader
node.KiLoRALoRALoader.desc: Use it in place of Load LoRA. It patches CLIP like Load LoRA. The model LoRAs of all chained KiLoRA LoRA Loaders are routed together when sampling starts. With mix set to stack, the output is the same as Load LoRA.
tip.dropin_clip: The text encoder. It gets the LoRA the same way as with Load LoRA.
tip.dropin_strength_model: The LoRA weight on the model, as in Load LoRA. Routing keeps this strength for each LoRA.
tip.dropin_strength_clip: The LoRA weight on the text encoder, as in Load LoRA.
tip.dropin_lora_stack: Optional. More LoRAs as a list of (LoRA file, strength model, strength clip). They load before the LoRA of this node.
tip.dropin_settings: Optional. KiLoRA settings. Without them, the defaults apply.
otip.dropin_model: The model. The LoRAs are routed when sampling starts.
otip.dropin_clip: The text encoder with the LoRA.
node.KiLoRARouteLoaded.name: KiLoRA Route Loaded LoRAs
node.KiLoRARouteLoaded.desc: Put it after your LoRA loaders. It takes the LoRAs that the loaders put on the model and routes them with KiLoRA. Each LoRA keeps its model strength. CLIP is not changed. If the LoRAs cannot be told apart, they stay as loaded and the report says so.
tip.takeover_model: The model after your LoRA loaders. The original model is not changed.
tip.takeover_settings: Optional. KiLoRA settings. Without them, the defaults apply.
otip.takeover_model: The model with the loaded LoRAs routed.
node.KiLoRARouteRecord.name: KiLoRA Route Record
node.KiLoRARouteRecord.desc: Records where each LoRA acts while the sampler runs. Connect its model to the sampler and its routes to KiLoRA Route Map.
node.KiLoRARouteMap.name: KiLoRA Route Map
node.KiLoRARouteMap.desc: Shows where each LoRA acted in the last sampled image: one colored panel per LoRA, with a legend. Connect the routes of KiLoRA Route Record and the decoded image.
tip.route_model: The model with KiLoRA routing (after KiLoRA Apply or a KiLoRA loader).
tip.routes: The routes of KiLoRA Route Record.
tip.route_image: The decoded image of the same sampler run.
tip.route_labels: The LoRA names, separated by commas, in load order. Missing names become LoRA 1, LoRA 2, and so on.
otip.route_model: The model that records the routing. Connect it to the sampler.
otip.routes: The recorded routing shares. Connect them to KiLoRA Route Map.
otip.route_map: One panel per LoRA: the image, colored where the LoRA acted. A stronger color is a larger share.
err.no_routes: No routing was recorded. Connect the model of KiLoRA Route Record to the sampler, and make sure that the model has KiLoRA routing.
node.KiLoRATriggerWords.name: KiLoRA Trigger Words
node.KiLoRATriggerWords.desc: Shows the trigger words of a LoRA file, from its metadata, its training tags and a Civitai sidecar.
tip.lora_stack: Optional. A LoRA stack: file, model strength, clip strength. Each entry is added with the model strength. When this is connected, it is used instead of the LoRA file above.
tip.trigger_stack: Optional. A LoRA stack. Trigger words of those files are added after the LoRA file above.
tip.segs: Optional. Regions from Impact Pack (SEGS). Their masks are joined into one mask and used as the region instead of the mask.
err.segs: SEGS must be a shape and a list of segments, each with a mask and a crop.
tip.apply_clip: Optional. The text encoder layers of the mods and LoRA files apply to this CLIP, as ComfyUI's LoRA loader does. Use the clip output for the prompt.
otip.clip_with: The CLIP with the text encoder layers of the mods. Without text encoder layers it is the CLIP you connected.
msg.roles_edit_hint: {name} looks like an edit LoRA. With reference images it changes only the target tokens. If it reads the reference images, set its roles in KiLoRA Token Roles.
err.roles_empty: The mod list is empty. Add a mod before KiLoRA Token Roles.
node.KiLoRATokenRoles.name: KiLoRA Mod List: Token Roles
node.KiLoRATokenRoles.desc: Sets which tokens the mods of a mod list change in an editing workflow: the target image, the reference images or the text. Other tokens keep the base weights.
tip.token_roles: auto: the mod's own policy, else the LoRA file's, else the target tokens when reference images are present. target: the image being made. reference: the reference images. all: every token, as without roles.
tip.token_roles_custom: Optional. A role list that replaces the choice above, for example reference:0+text for the first reference image and the text.
tip.linear_jump: Approximate later depth passes with a fitted map. Off by default; image quality can change.
tip.jump_threshold: Maximum relative fitting error for using the approximation at a layer. Higher errors keep the full loop.
tip.route_freeze: Speed. From this sampling progress on (0.4: after 40% of the steps), each layer stops routing: it keeps the expert weights and gate of that step as fixed scales and runs one low-rank product, about as fast as a plain LoRA. 0 uses the mod's value (off by default).
tip.radial_step: Accumulate depth loop. The step size of the part of each later depth step that changes the size of the change along its current direction. 1 adds it as is. 0 keeps the size, so only the direction changes. With 1, 1 and a budget of 0, the depth steps add as before. The default is 0.5.
tip.orthogonal_step: Accumulate depth loop. The step size of the part of each later depth step that changes the direction of the change. 1 adds it as is. 0 keeps the direction, so only the size changes.
tip.radial_budget: Accumulate depth loop. A size limit for the radial step, per token: this many times the size of the change after the first depth step. The orthogonal part is not cut. 0 is off.
node.KiLoRATwoPanels.name: KiLoRA Mod List: Two Panels
node.KiLoRATwoPanels.desc: Marks a two-panel canvas. One panel holds the reference picture and the other is the image being made. Mods on auto roles change only the target panel. Applies to every mod of the list.
tip.reference_side: The side of the canvas that holds the reference picture.
tip.panel_split: The part of the canvas width (left, right) or height (top, bottom) that the reference panel covers.
err.panels_empty: The mod list is empty. Add a mod before KiLoRA Two Panels.
node.KiLoRARegionIsolation.name: KiLoRA Mod List: Region Isolation
node.KiLoRARegionIsolation.desc: Experimental. Keeps the area outside the KiLoRA regions as the base model makes it. In the first part of sampling, a base-only branch runs next to the sampler, and the outside follows it. Each step in that part costs one extra model call. Connect it after KiLoRA Apply.
tip.isolation_strength: How far the outside follows the base model. 1: fully, 0: off.
tip.isolation_until: The part of the sampler steps that the isolation acts in, from the start. After it, the image settles freely, so the edge can heal.
tip.feather: The soft edge of the regions, in pixels. Larger values blend the edge over a wider band.
msg.region_isolation_on: Region isolation: {regions} regions, strength {strength}, in the first {until} of the sampler steps.
tip.isolation_sets: Optional. The mod list whose regions to isolate (the same list as on KiLoRA Apply). Without it, the regions of the list that KiLoRA Apply loaded.
node.KiLoRAPalette.name: KiLoRA Palette
node.KiLoRAPalette.desc: Loads a saved palette (LoRA and mod files with strengths, roles and trigger words) as a mod list. Shuffle picks a different set for each seed.
node.KiLoRASavePalette.name: KiLoRA Save Palette
node.KiLoRASavePalette.desc: Saves a mod list as a palette file without weights, for example a Shuffle pick.
tip.palette_file: A palette from the kilora_palettes folder, or a mod pack from models/kilora.
tip.shuffle: On: pick a seeded subset of the palette, with random strengths in the range.
tip.pick_min: Shuffle: the fewest entries to pick.
tip.pick_max: Shuffle: the most entries to pick.
tip.strength_min: Shuffle: the lowest strength of a picked entry.
tip.strength_max: Shuffle: the highest strength of a picked entry.
tip.palette_seed: Shuffle: the same seed gives the same pick.
tip.palette_in_sets: Optional. The palette entries are added to this mod list.
tip.mask_a: Optional. The region of the entries with region a.
tip.mask_b: Optional. The region of the entries with region b.
tip.palette_sets: The mod list to save, for example the sets output of KiLoRA Palette.
tip.palette_name: The name shown for the palette.
tip.palette_filename: The file name, without the ending.
tip.palette_settings: Optional. The KiLoRA Apply settings saved with the palette.
otip.palette_triggers: The trigger words of the loaded entries, for the prompt.
otip.palette_settings: The palette's settings. Connect them to KiLoRA Apply Mod List.
tip.axis: auto: choose the axis from LoRA metadata, trigger words, tags or file name. creative: route with creative LoRAs. functional: a plain LoRA on its own axis. ip: the character or prop axis: a plain LoRA on its own axis, and several IP LoRAs route together. shared: route with each active axis.
msg.axis_hint: {name} looks like a functional LoRA (edit, outpaint, few-step or control). To keep it at its full strength on its own loop, set its axis to functional in KiLoRA Mod List: Add LoRA.
node.KiLoRATimeline.name: KiLoRA Timeline
node.KiLoRATimeline.desc: Sets one value over the run: the strength of a mod, or when it is active, for example. Chain Timeline nodes to add rows, and connect the last one to KiLoRA Apply or the LoRA loader. The preview plots every row.
tip.timeline_target: all, an axis (creative, functional or ip), or the file name of a mod or LoRA in the mod list, without the extension.
tip.timeline_quantity: What the row sets. strength multiplies the strength. active turns the mod on (1) or off (0). route_freeze and gate_kappa replace the inputs of KiLoRA Apply. The region quantities set the strength of that effect over time. depth_map and depth_base control the depth map (target all).
tip.timeline_curve: Keyframes such as 0:1, 0.3:0.6, 1:0.2 (position:value), or an expression with t, step, steps and sigma, for example 1 - t.
tip.timeline_clock: What the keyframe positions mean. progress: 0 at the first step, 1 at the last. step: the step number. sigma: the noise level.
tip.timeline_interpolation: linear: values blend between keyframes. step: each value holds until the next keyframe.
tip.timeline_in: Optional. Rows from another Timeline node; this node adds its rows after them.
tip.timeline_rows: Optional. More rows, one per line: target | quantity | curve, then optional | clock and | interpolation.
otip.timeline: All rows. Connect it to KiLoRA Apply or to the next Timeline node.
otip.timeline_preview: Every row over the run: progress across, value up.
tip.apply_timeline: Optional. Time-dependent values from KiLoRA Timeline. Without it nothing changes.
node.KiLoRADepthMap.name: KiLoRA Depth Map
node.KiLoRADepthMap.desc: A depth per image area, from a mask (SAM2 and other segmenters) or an image (its brightness: depth, lineart or pose maps from ControlNet preprocessors). Until start, every area runs one depth, so the layout forms as usual. Then each area runs its own depth. Connect it to KiLoRA Apply or KiLoRA LoRA Loader. Without a mask or an image, source auto measures the map during sampling: more depth on detail and where the LoRAs change the image most, with the same mean depth.
tip.min_depth: The depth where the map is 0 (black).
tip.max_depth: The depth where the map is 1 (white).
tip.depth_invert: Swap black and white before the depths are set.
tip.depth_gamma: Shapes the map before the depths are set: above 1 keeps more of it near min_depth, below 1 near max_depth.
tip.depth_feather: The soft edge of the map, in pixels. A soft edge avoids a visible seam between depths.
tip.depth_start: The sampling progress from which the map applies (0.3: after 30% of the steps). Before it every area runs base, so the layout stays as with one depth.
tip.depth_base: The depth of every area before start, and of text tokens. -1: the mean depth of the map, rounded.
tip.depth_mask: A mask, for example from SAM2. 1 gives max_depth. If an image is also connected, the mask is used.
tip.depth_image: An image. Its brightness is the map, for example the output of a depth, lineart or pose preprocessor.
tip.axis_alpha: Off is the default. Creative and IP share one budget per token. Auto blends them using previous-step trigger attention, or alpha_mask when connected.
tip.depth_map: Optional. A depth per image area from KiLoRA Depth Map. From its start progress on, it replaces the depth on image tokens.
otip.depth_map: The depth map. Connect it to the depth_map input of KiLoRA Apply or KiLoRA LoRA Loader.
otip.depth_map_preview: The map as an image: black is min_depth, white is max_depth.
node.KiLoRALayerConditioning.name: KiLoRA Layer
node.KiLoRALayerConditioning.desc: Selects the axes for this conditioning and sets its mask.
tip.layer: The axis for this layer. creative also runs functional.
tip.alpha_source: mask uses the connected mask. attention uses the previous step’s trigger maps for IP and the complement for creative.
node.KiLoRALayerFilter.name: KiLoRA Layer Filter
node.KiLoRALayerFilter.desc: Limit added model function patches to one layer. Weight and object patches remain global.
tip.layer_filter_layer: The layer where the plugin runs.
tip.alpha_mask: Optional IP alpha mask when axis_alpha is auto. It replaces trigger maps and its edge is feathered over 16 pixels. With axis_alpha off it has no effect.
tip.crop: off: the whole image. auto: faster, crops the late steps with surrounding context.
tip.batch: Run this layer in one batched model call with the other layers. Off: each layer runs as its own call, which is exact and at 1024 pixels faster. Turn it on for all layers to batch them.
tip.compose: separate: each layer runs as its own model call. single: all layers run in one model call per guidance branch, and each image area reads its own layer text. Select single on every layer. The crop input is not used with single.
tip.region_penalty: With compose single: how strongly image areas of different layers stop reading each other in the early steps. 0 turns it off. The value of the first layer is used, and every layer must set the same value.
tip.mount_scope: With compose single: all applies a layer's mods to the image area of the layer and to its own text. cross_kv applies them only to the cross-attention keys and values of its own text, so a LoRA without those weights has no effect. Every layer must set the same value.
node.KiLoRASaveRecipe.name: KiLoRA Save Recipe
node.KiLoRASaveRecipe.desc: Saves a mod list and settings as references without copying the weights.
tip.recipe_filename: The name of the recipe file.
tip.recipe_name: The name shown for the recipe.
tip.recipe_settings: Optional settings to save with the recipe.
tip.expert_text: Auto prepares separate text conditioning for experts in layered mode. Off keeps the shared text path.
node.KiLoRADirectionNodes.name: KiLoRA Direction Nodes
node.KiLoRADirectionNodes.desc: Add direction nodes from a stored library basis or one complete direction file.
tip.direction_chunk: Number of output directions per node.
tip.direction_library: Library index folder; empty uses the default.
tip.mode: Shuffle: random picks or picks based on local counts.
tip.reset_state: Clear the local Shuffle counts for this palette.
tip.shuffle_reward: Learn mode: rate the seeded pick. Restore the image seed and settings, with no intervening state changes; use fixed seed, then set reward back to none.
node.KiLoRAClearHistory.name: KiLoRA Clear Local History
node.KiLoRAClearHistory.desc: Remove the local history of applied chains.
tip.record_history: Record file hashes and date locally. Turn off to stop recording.
node.KiLoRASuggestions.name: KiLoRA Mod List: Suggest LoRAs
node.KiLoRASuggestions.desc: Lists installed LoRAs by co-usage or embedding similarity.
tip.suggestion_sets: The current mod list used to find related LoRAs.
otip.suggestions: Up to five installed LoRA files and their scores.
node.KiLoRASimilarLoRAs.name: KiLoRA Similar LoRAs
tip.similar_count: Maximum number of similar LoRAs to list.
tip.similar_space: Compare pooled content keys or vectors from a trained model.
tip.similar_model_path: Path to a saved LayerChain model directory. The library basis must match the basis used to train it.
node.KiLoRASimilarLoRAs.desc: Find installed LoRAs with similar content features in the same base family.
tip.variation: Entry sampling temperature for derived routing. Zero selects deterministically.
node.KiLoRALoRALibrary.name: KiLoRA LoRA Library
node.KiLoRALoRALibrary.desc: Select LoRAs at the first sampling step and save a recipe.
tip.library_folders: One LoRA folder path per line.
tip.library_prompt: Text used to find matching LoRAs.
tip.library_count: Maximum number of LoRAs to select.
otip.library_recipe: Path of the recipe written after the first sampling step.
library.no_blocks: No transformer blocks found for the library probe
library.none: No files met the relevance threshold.
library.failed: No selected files could be loaded.
library.batch: Selection uses the first batch item.
library.pending: selection runs at the first step
tip.editor_path_angle: Rotation angle in radians for editor path merging. Default: 0.05.
tip.cross_token_region: Weight for the token and region routing score product.
tip.cross_token_prompt: Weight for the token and prompt routing score product.
tip.cross_token_timestep: Weight for the token and timestep routing score product.
tip.routing_features: Collect optional inputs for routing scores.
tip.editor_cross_layer: Use recorded links in the path merge. Off by default. unchanged keeps the current choice.
tip.suggest_by: Choose co-usage, similarity, a missing direction, or similarity to kept entries. Complementary scores the uncovered embedding norm times cosine with the current mean.
suggestions.no_likes: No kept images found; using similar.
suggestions.missing: Some embeddings are unavailable; using co-usage for those LoRAs.
tip.embedding_model_path: Path to the local embedding model used by Shuffle in embedding mode.
palette.embedding_empty: Shuffle embedding model path is empty; using entry counts.
tip.attention_route: Deprecated and ignored. Attention projections use the same routing and depth as other mounts.
tip.attention_route_cap: Deprecated and ignored. Kept to preserve saved workflow widget positions.
tip.size_norm: off: the strength as given. weight: the strength is multiplied by one number for the whole file. The number only shrinks: a file larger than a typical library LoRA is brought down to that size. A weaker file always keeps its own size, also with radial budget on. The ratios inside the file do not change.
tip.apply_size_norm: off: each LoRA entry uses its own size norm setting. weight: every LoRA entry of the chain gets one size number per file. The number only shrinks: a file larger than a typical library LoRA is brought down to that size. A weaker file always keeps its own size, also with radial budget on. The report names the rule for each file. Mods and packs keep their stored strength.
tip.direction_fine: Allow up to 64 depth steps for direction nodes.
tip.direction_candidates: Maximum direction nodes scored per token in fine mode.
tip.editor_merge_residual: Keep the part outside the direction set, or drop it. Default: keep.
tip.editor_explore: Favor less-used directions in inspiration draws. Zero turns this off. Explore draws keep no path-merge residuals, even with merge residual set to keep.
tip.editor_term_budget: Compact a node after its term count exceeds this number. Default: 64.
node.KiLoRAPrepareLoRAs.name: KiLoRA Prepare LoRAs
node.KiLoRAPrepareLoRAs.desc: Prepare supported LoRA files and routing keys. Connect a model to prepare the selected mix in the listed order.
tip.prepare_paths: One path per line, relative to a LoRA folder. Leave empty to select all files.
tip.prepare_model: Optional model for preparing keys for this exact model and mix.
tip.prepare_family: Optional model family for preparing files without a model.
tip.gate_stats: fused (default) is faster. torch reproduces images made before this release. KILORA_GATE_STATS overrides this setting.
tip.content_keys: per_expert (default) caches keys for each LoRA. mix is the compatibility choice. KILORA_CONTENT_KEYS overrides this setting.
tip.lycoris_apply: For routed LoKr and LoHa files, truncated applies the low-rank change; exact applies the whole change.
tip.export_format: Choose a KiLoRA mod or a plain LoRA export.
tip.import_edits: Edits change each LoRA core matrix and strength per layer, plus pack terms. Source files are never written. off restores the imported LoRAs exactly. unchanged keeps the current choice.
tip.import_controller: r1: baseline write rule (default). rprop: sign controller. unchanged keeps the current choice.
tip.import_editor: A live-mode editor file (.kedit) from models/kilora, made for this base model. Choose Imported LoRAs for an imported stack; no live mod or editor file is needed.
err.choose_live_session: Choose a session ID when several live sessions are loaded.
err.import_options: These settings require an imported LoRA session.
tip.applied_imports: Put before the sampler to record a live mod or imported LoRAs, even without a live mod.
tip.learn: How a write learns. measure: measure the slopes with extra forward passes (the default). prediction: solve the update in closed form from the prediction errors that the generation recorded, with no measurement pass; the guard runs on the next generation. unchanged keeps the current choice.
msg.prediction_guard_deferred: Guard deferred to the next generation.
msg.prediction_guard_passed: Guard of the previous prediction write: passed.
msg.prediction_guard_skipped: Guard of the previous prediction write skipped: {why}
msg.prediction_guard_stale: the write is no longer the last commit.
msg.prediction_rolled_back: The previous prediction write was rolled back: {why}
node.KiLoRAMentionPrompt.name: KiLoRA Mention Prompt
node.KiLoRAMentionPrompt.desc: Encode a prompt in which @name calls a LoRA from the library. The mentions are removed before the text encoder and added to the mod list.
tip.mention_text: The prompt. Write @name or @name:0.5 to call a LoRA file by its file name. Without a value, the strength is 0.7.
tip.mention_sets: Optional. The mentioned LoRAs are added to this mod list.
tip.mention_layer: global: the mentioned LoRAs use their own axis. An axis: the mentioned LoRAs follow the mask of that layer.
otip.mention_conditioning: The conditioning of the text without mentions.
otip.mention_sets: The mod list with one entry for each mention. Connect it to KiLoRA Apply Mod List.
otip.mention_report: Which file each mention uses, and which trigger words were added to the prompt.
mention.layer_differs: KiLoRA Layer is set to {layer}, but the mentions of this conditioning are bound to {mention}. The mentioned LoRAs follow {mention}.
err.mention_unknown: No LoRA file is named @{name}. Similar names: {closest}.
err.mention_ambiguous: Several LoRA files are named @{name}: {files}. Rename one of them.
mention.fallback: @{name}: no baked file, so the LoRA file is used and its trigger words are added to the prompt: {words}.
mention.several: @{name}: baked files for several base models, so the LoRA file is used and its trigger words are added to the prompt: {words}.
auto_alpha.probe_ids: Trigger attention maps are off: probe keys need one row of prompt token ids.
auto_alpha.probe_missing: Trigger attention maps are off: a mentioned IP entry has no trigger ids.
auto_alpha.probe_encoding: Trigger attention maps are off: the probe encoding needs one caption with all trigger tokens.
auto_alpha.probe_failed: Trigger attention maps are off: probe keys are unavailable ({reason}).
auto_alpha.probe_projection: Trigger attention maps are off: a sampled layer has no probe key projection.
tip.prompt_solve_subjects: One subject per line. An LLM node can supply this text.
tip.prompt_solve_style: Full style description used by the target prompt.
tip.prompt_solve_cue: Short cue in the student prompt and the exported trigger words.
tip.prompt_solve_label: Letters, numbers, underscores or dashes. Used in the output filename.
tip.prompt_solve_json: Optional JSON concepts or explicit pairs. Overrides the text fields.
tip.prompt_solve_prompt_set: Concepts and prompt pairs. Chain Prompt Set nodes to add concepts.
tip.prompt_solve_model: Base model used for sampling and fitting the LoRA.
tip.prompt_solve_clip: Text encoder for target, student and negative prompts.
tip.prompt_solve_name: Output file stem. Batch sets with one shared name receive numbered stems.
tip.prompt_solve_mode: single writes one LoRA per concept; joint fits all concepts into one LoRA.
tip.prompt_solve_rank: Rank of each fitted projection. Default 16.
tip.prompt_solve_steps: Target trajectory steps. 0 uses the model family's default.
tip.prompt_solve_size: Square image size in pixels, a multiple of 16. 0 uses the model family's default.
tip.prompt_solve_cfg: Guidance strength of the target trajectories. -1 uses the model family's default.
tip.prompt_solve_negative_prompt: Negative conditioning for the target trajectories.
tip.prompt_solve_overwrite: Replace an existing file with the same name. Otherwise reuse a matching file, and save new inputs under a name with a short hash.
tip.prompt_solve_sets: Append solved files at strength 0.7 to this mod list.
tip.prompt_solve_overlap_penalty: 0 is off. With several concepts in single mode, each concept is solved again with a penalty on the input directions of the other concepts. Larger values make the concepts overlap less.
tip.prompt_solve_deflate: Off by default. In single mode, the concepts are solved in their order. Each later concept fits its target minus the changes of the earlier concepts.
node.KiLoRAPromptSet.name: KiLoRA Prompt Set
node.KiLoRAPromptSet.desc: Build prompt pairs from subjects, style and cue, or JSON. Chain nodes to add concepts.
node.KiLoRASolveFromPrompts.name: KiLoRA Solve LoRA From Prompts
node.KiLoRASolveFromPrompts.desc: Solve plain LoRAs from prompt sets with the connected model and CLIP. Files go to models/loras/kilora-solved/.
otip.prompt_solve_KiLoRASolveFromPrompts: One completed LoRA path per line.
Solved LoRAs imported at strength 0.7, ready for KiLoRA Apply.
Memory estimate, written files and reused files.
node.KiLoRAPack.name: KiLoRA Pack
node.KiLoRAPack.desc: Bundle mods into models/kilora/<name>.kpack.json. Copy the pack and mods into one folder for sharing.
tip.solve_output: lora writes plain LoRAs; kmod writes KiLoRA mods; both lists both formats.
tip.solve_preview: The first image is stored as the preview in each solved mod.
otip.pack_path: Saved .kpack.json file. Load it with KiLoRA Palette.
otip.pack_report: Each mod ID, version, cue and preview availability.
tip.pack_mods: One mod filename or path per line. Accepts solve paths; plain LoRA lines are ignored.
tip.pack_strength: Strength for every mod entry. Default 0.7.
tip.pack_depth: -1 uses the mod settings; zero or greater stores a pack depth.
tip.pack_copy_mods: Copy the mods and pack into models/kilora/<name>/ for sharing.
node.KiLoRABuildEditorPack.name: KiLoRA Live: Build Editor Pack
node.KiLoRABuildEditorPack.desc: Build editor packs for live mode from the connected model and CLIP. The packs go to models/kilora/<name>/. Needs the plugin kilora-editor-chunk.
tip.build_pack_model: The base model. With one live mod on it, the packs are for that mod. Without a live mod, they are for the base model.
tip.build_pack_clip: The text encoder of the model. It encodes each prompt and the empty caption.
tip.build_pack_name: The folder name in models/kilora. A new build with the same name replaces the folder.
tip.build_pack_prompts: JSON that maps each family name to a list of prompts. A family name that starts with _ adds to the common pack only.
tip.build_pack_base_family: The base model family. auto uses the family of the loaded model.
tip.build_pack_draws: Noise draws per prompt and caption. More draws give smoother directions and take longer.
tip.build_pack_common: The number of directions in the common pack.
tip.build_pack_family: The number of directions in each family pack.
tip.build_pack_loras: LoRA files from models/loras that are applied while the packs are built. One name per line, optionally name:strength.
tip.build_pack_orthogonalize: Remove the common directions and the earlier family packs from each family pack.
tip.build_pack_size: Image size in pixels. 0 uses the default of the base family.
tip.build_pack_steps: Sampler steps per image. 0 uses the default of the base family.
tip.build_pack_seed: The first seed of the images and noise draws.
otip.build_pack_path: The folder with the packs and the editor file. KiLoRA Live Packs finds the packs there.
otip.build_pack_report: Packs, directions per pack, events, seconds and the memory estimate.
err.pack_plugin_missing: KiLoRA Live: Build Editor Pack needs the plugin {plugin}. Install {plugin} in the Python of ComfyUI, then restart ComfyUI.
err.pack_prompts: Prompts must be a JSON object that maps each family name to a list of prompts ({reason}).
err.pack_name: Set a name with letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.
pack_build.report: Wrote {packs} packs to {folder}. Directions per pack: {directions}.
pack_build.events: Events: {events} ({reused} from the cache). Time: {seconds} s.
pack_build.no_estimate: Memory estimate: none on the live mod path.
pack_build.found: KiLoRA Live Packs finds {found} packs in the folder.
node.KiLoRASolveFromImages.name: KiLoRA Solve LoRA From Images
node.KiLoRASolveFromImages.desc: Solve a LoRA with the shared look of at least three images, for example a style. A set that fails the held-out guard is not saved. Files go to models/loras/kilora-solved/. You are responsible for the rights to the images you use.
tip.image_solve_contrast_components: Add up to four principal directions of the per-image mean contrasts to the shared mean. Limited to the number of fitted images minus one, after holding out images. Default 4; 0 writes the previous mean-only weights. The fit still uses Rank. Applies only to this unmasked image solve.
tip.image_solve_vae: VAE for encoding images into the connected model’s latent format.
tip.image_solve_name: Output filename stem: letters, numbers, underscores or dashes.
tip.image_solve_cue: Cue used with each caption on both sides and stored as the LoRA trigger words.
tip.image_solve_ignore_guard: Save even if held-out denoising loss does not improve. Adds a warning to the report.
tip.image_solve_images: IMAGE batch. Use either images or folder. You are responsible for the rights to these images.
tip.image_solve_captions: One caption per image, one line per caption. Leave empty to use the cue alone for all images.
tip.image_solve_folder: Folder of images with optional same-name .txt captions. Use either folder or images.
tip.image_solve_masks: One mask per image, in image order. The solve learns only the masked region. Leave this empty to use the whole image.
tip.image_solve_two_stage: Solve style first, then character with that style active on the student. Masks select the character; their inverse selects style. Without masks, both use whole images. Writes separate creative style and ip character files.
tip.image_solve_mask_contrast: With masks, tokens compares each masked token and mean compares the masked average. Ignored without masks.
otip.image_solve_report: Image and hold-out counts, contrast components, measured rank per mount (singular values above 0.001 of the largest), solve times, both guard losses, relative gain and the saved or reused path.
node.KiLoRALiveLearnFromImages.name: KiLoRA Live: Learn From Images
node.KiLoRALiveLearnFromImages.desc: Learn what an image set has in common into the live state, as one commit on a new branch. Every fifth image is held out to check the change. You are responsible for the rights to the images you use.
tip.learn_images_cue: Cue added to each caption, for example a style word.
tip.learn_images_ignore_guard: Commit the change even if the held-out loss goes up or the drift is over the bound. Adds a warning to the report.
tip.learn_images_clip: Text encoder for the captions and the drift prompts. Required.
otip.learn_images_path: The same record, for the next live node.
otip.learn_images_report: Held-out loss without and with the change, relative gain, drift, write norm, branch and time.
tip.learn_images_mounts: Optional mount name patterns, one per line or separated by commas, for example transformer_blocks.1*. Only matching mounts change. Empty: all mounts.
tip.learn_images_t_min: Lowest sampler time of the samples, from 0 (last step, least noise) to 1 (first step, most noise). Low noise changes detail and texture.
tip.learn_images_t_max: Highest sampler time of the samples, from 0 to 1. High noise changes composition and overall style. With 0 and 1, all steps are used.
tip.learn_images_mask: Optional region mask, resized to the latent tokens. Only white areas give the change; the error in black areas is set to 0.
tip.learn_images_axis: Optional editor axis. Only the frames of LoRAs on this axis give terms. all: every axis.
tip.learn_images_single_image: Learn from exactly one image. No set mean is taken and the held-out loss guard is off. The report warns that the result can copy the image content. The drift check stays on.
tip.entry_start: Sampling progress where this LoRA starts acting (0 to 1, inclusive).
tip.entry_end: Sampling progress where this LoRA stops acting (0 to 1, inclusive).
tip.direction_file: Optional path to a LoRA direction file with kilora_directions metadata. When set, use one node with the full saved change at each mount. Library path, chunk, fine and candidates apply only to the library basis.
tip.depth_source: Where the map comes from. mask or image: the connected input (the mask comes first). auto: measured at the step of start from the image detail, the KiLoRA change and the route disagreement. Without a connected mask or image, auto is used.
tip.mean_depth: auto: the mean depth over the image. -1 uses the depth of KiLoRA Apply, so the cost stays the same as that uniform depth. Lower values are faster.
tip.detail_weight: auto: the weight of the image detail (the fine structure of the clean image estimate).
tip.change_weight: auto: the weight of the KiLoRA change (where the LoRAs change the image most).
tip.disagreement_weight: auto: the weight of the route disagreement (where the LoRAs compete). 0 turns it off.
tip.smooth: auto: the Gaussian width in tokens that smooths the combined map before the depths are chosen. The map of a painted image is noisy; 2 gives areas. 0 turns it off.
tip.probe_rows: Collect write measurements during rendering. On by default. Image learning and writes without a complete render measurement use their own noise samples.
tip.probe_budget: Maximum perturbed rows per render, counting caption and empty-caption rows. The default 2 samples one caption for one antithetic pair per render. The write seed selects caption or empty caption with equal probability. Budgets of 4 or more retain both captions. Complete pairs are retained; fewer than two rows skips probes. Acceptance retains both captions for the prompt and collapse guard. Clean reference and acceptance rows are additional. Larger budgets allow more draws when the session is idle. Pairs run over consecutive eligible sampling steps, with two caption rows per probe call. A short schedule falls back to ordinary write samples.
tip.probe_call: Separate runs each probe after the image call. Larger batches can change image-row rounding even on the CPU, so separate is the only supported value. The image call keeps its original rows. Probe measurements do not update image records or step caches.
tip.probe_draws: Maximum noise draws collected in a render. 0 uses the forward draws setting; -1 keeps the current value. Complete positive and negative pairs are kept. Fewer draws reduce the render work.
tip.image_solve_mask_start: With masks, start the aligned student at this fraction of the full schedule. Default 0.4. Ignored without masks.
tip.image_solve_mask_samples: With masks, space- or comma-separated fractions of the full schedule, at or after Mask start and at most 1.0, for example 0.5 0.75 1.0. Empty keeps the three original sample positions. Ignored without masks.
tip.image_solve_refit_rounds: Additional closed-form solves after resampling student trajectories with the previous solution active. 0 keeps the original solve; up to 8 rounds. Only the last result is checked and saved.
tip.image_solve_guard_rule: loss chooses the lowest held-out loss below the base loss, within the live drift bound. drift chooses the largest scale within that bound with loss at most 1.25 times the base loss. Default loss.
tip.image_solve_trajectory_check: Check two unrelated prompts with 8 sampling steps using the first solve seed, size and cfg. Reject a scale if latent spatial standard deviation falls below 0.5 times the base or relative L2 distance exceeds 1.0, then try smaller allowed scales. No VAE decoding. Default off.
